proposal:
# Window 227-slice: ship the card 227 slice as amended

Proposal: the slice in .mob/records/227/turn-slice-architect.md in this repository (committed; read the whole file): the slice (4037cfe), the section "Security review at slice (ctx-3)" (c6b831c, CHANGES NEEDED, three must-fix items) and the section "Amendment for the security review (ctx-2)" (2e2e0f3), which accepts the command-position scan, the main form families, the literal-path allow-list and fail-closed coverage into card 227, and moves hidden, encoded and non-shell forms, written-file scanning and the opt-in blocking hook to a follow-up. Card text: board/227-*.md. Follow-up filed as card 228 (board/228-*.md).

Facilitator note: Done check 1 says the scan "blocks"; this slice reads that as: the scan reports the command and the record check fails, after the fact; blocking before a command runs is card 228's opt-in hook. Whether "block" in the product owner's ruling requires prevention before execution is a direction question put to the product owner now; if the owner says yes, the hook moves back into 227 and the slice is re-polled. The card exceeds the per-card guide by one increment and one concern because of the owner's one-card ruling; every commit stays within D136.
